G1200.def:
δεσμο-φύλαξ, -κος, ὁ
(δεσμός, φύλαξ), 
a prison-keeper, gaoler: Actes 16:23, 27, 36 (cf. ἀρχιδ-, Genèse 39:21).†

G1201.def:
δεσμωτήριον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX for בֵּית סֹהַר (Ge), אָסִיר ;] 
a prison: Matthieu 11:2, Actes 5:21, 23 16:26.†

G1202.def:
δεσμώτης, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for אסר, מַסְגֵּר ;] 
a prisoner: Actes 27:1, 42.†

G1203.def:
δεσπότης, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for אָדוֹן, אֲדֹנָי; in Jdth.9:17, δ. τ. οὐρανῶν κ. τ. γῆς]; 
a master, lord, correlative of δοῦλος, οἰκέτης: 1 Timothée 6:1, 2, 2 Timothée 2:21, Tite 2:9, 1 Pierre 2:18; as title of God, voc., δέσποτα (so usually in LXX), Luc 2:29, Actes 4:24; ὁ δ. = voc. δέσποτα (cf. B1., § 33, 4), Apocalypse 6:10; of Christ, 2 Pierre 2:1, Ju 4, R, txt. (but cf. mg.).†
SYN.: κύριος (which see), implying limitation of authority and a more general relation than δ., which "denoted absolute ownership and uncontrolled power" (Thayer).

G1205.def:
δεῦτε 
adv., as pl. of δεῦρο, 1. (b), which see, [in LXX chiefly for לְכוּ ;] 
come on! come here! come!: with imperat., Matthieu 25:34 28:6, Jean 4:29 21:12, Apocalypse 19:17; with subjc., Matthieu 21:38, Marc 12:7; before ὀπίσω, Matthieu 4:19, Marc 1:17; πρός, Matthieu 11:28; εἰς, Matthieu 22:4, Marc 6:31.†

G1206.def:
δευτεραῖος, -α, -ον
(δεύτερος), 
adj. with adverbial sense; 
on the second day: δευτεραῖοι ἤλθομεν, Actes 28:13.†

G1207.def:
δευτερό-πρωτος, -ον 
second first (in what sense, there is no satisfactory explanation. The reading is prob. not original, see ICC, in l.; DCG, i, 411; ii, 541, 724): Luc 6:1, WH, mg., R, mg.†

G1208.def:
δεῦτερος, -α, -ον, 
second in order, with or without idea of time: Matthieu 22:26, 39, al.; θάνατος, Apocalypse 2:11 20:14 21:8; χάρις, 2 Corinthiens 1:15. In neut. as adv., secondly, a second time; opposite to πρῶτον: Jean 3:4 21:16, 1 Corinthiens 12:28, Apocalypse 19:3; τὸ δ., 2 Corinthiens 13:2, Ju 5; ἐν τ. δ., at the second time: Actes 7:13; in later usage (as 1Ma.9:1), ἐκ δ., Marc 14:72, Jean 9:24, Actes 11:9, Hébreux 9:28.

G1209.def:
δέχομαι, depon. mid., 
[in LXX chiefly for לקח ;] 
to receive, accept; 
__1. with accusative of thing(s), of taking or accepting what is offered: γράμματα, Luc 16:6, 7; id. in different sense, Actes 28:21; ποτήριον, Luc 22:17; παιδίον (εἰς τ. ἀγκάλας), Luc 2:28; περικεφαλαίαν, μάχαιραν, Éphésiens 6:17; ἐπιστολάς, Actes 22:5; τ. βασιλείαν τ. Θεοῦ, Marc 10:15, Luc 18:17; λογία ζῶντα, Actes 7:38; εὐαγγέλιον, 2 Corinthiens 11:4; τ. χάριν τ. Θεοῦ, 2 Corinthiens 6:1; metaphorically, of mental acceptance, Matthieu 11:14; τ. λόγον, Luc 8:13, Actes 8:14 11:1 17:11, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:6 2:13, Jacques 1:21; τὰ τ. πνεύματος, 1 Corinthiens 2:14; τ. παράκλησιν, 2 Corinthiens 8:17; τ. ἀγάπην τ. ἀληθείας, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:10. 
__2. with accusative of person(s), of receiving kindly or hospitably, Matthieu 10:14 40, 41, Marc 6:11, Luc 9:5 53 10:8, 10, Jean 4:45, 2 Corinthiens 7:15 11:16, Galates 4:14, Colossiens 4:10, Hébreux 11:31; παιδίον, Matthieu 18:5, Marc 9:37, Luc 9:48; εἰς οἴκους, σκηνάς, Luc 16:4, 9; δέξαι τ. πνεῦμά μου, Actes 7:59; ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν δέασθαι, Actes 3:21 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο, δια-, εἰσ-, ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, παρα-, προσ-, ὑπο-δέχομαι; Cremer, 174).†

G1210.def:
δέω (I), 
[in LXX chiefly for אסר ;] 
to tie, bind, fasten; 
__(1) with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς δεσμάς, Matthieu 13:30; of an ass, Matthieu 21:2, Marc 11:2, 4 Luc 19:30. 
__(2) with accusative of person(s), of swathing a dead body, ὀθονίοις, Jean 19:40; δεδομένος τ. πόδας . . . κειρίαις (Bl., §34, 6; Kühner 3, iii, 125), Jean 11:44; of binding with chains, ἀγγέλους, Apocalypse 9:14; a demoniac, πέδαις κ. ἁλύσεσι, Marc 5:3, 4; captives, Matthieu 12:29 14:3 22:13 27:2, Marc 3:27 6:17 15:1, 7, Jean 18:12, 24, Actes 9:2, 14, 21, 21:11, 13 22:5, 29 24:27, Colossiens 4:3, Apocalypse 20:2; ἁλύσεσι, Actes 12:6 21:33. Metaphorical, ὁ λόγος τ. Θεοῦ, 2 Timothée 2:9; of Satan binding by disease (MM, see word), Luc 13:16; of constraint or obligation, Actes 20:22; of the marriage bond, 1 Corinthiens 7:39; id. with dative of person(s), ἀνδρί, Romains 7:2; γυναικί, 1 Corinthiens 7:27; in Rabbinic lang. (Dalman, Words, 213f.), to forbid, declare forbidden, Matthieu 16:19 18:18 (cf. κατα-, περι-, συν-, ὐπο-δέω; Cremer, 82).
†

G1211.def:
δή 
consecutive co-ordinating particle with no exact equiv. in Eng., giving greater exactness and emphasis to the word or words to which it is attached; sometimes translatable as now therefore, then, verily, certainly. 
__1. With verbs: imperat., Actes 6:3 (WH, mg.) 13:2, 1 Corinthiens 6:20; hort. subjc., Luc 2:15, Actes 15:36; indic., δή που (Τ, δήπου, which see), Hébreux 2:16. 
__2. With pronouns: ὃ δή, now this is he who, Matthieu 13:23.†

G1212.def:
δῆλος, -η, -ον 
[in LXX for אוּר, etc. ;] 
__1. visible. 
__2. clear to the mind, evident: Matthieu 26:73; δ. (sc. ἐστίν), before ὅτι, 1 Corinthiens 15:27, Galates 3:11.†
SYN.: φανερός, with ref. to outward appearance, manifest as opposite to concealed; δ. with ref. to inner perception, evident, known, under­stood.

G1213.def:
δηλόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] 
to make plain, declare: with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 3:13, Colossiens 1:8, Hébreux 9:8 12:27; with dative of person(s), 2 Pierre 1:14; with dative of person(s), before περί (pass.), 1 Corinthiens 1:11; before εἰς, 1 Pierre 1:11.†
SYN.: ἐμφανίζω, to make manifest, render visible to the sight; δ. to render evident to the mind.

G1214.def:
Δημᾶς, ὁ
(perh. contracted from Δημήτριος), 
Demas, a companion of St. Paul: Colossiens 4:14, Phm 24, 2 Timothée 4:10.†

G1215.def:
δημηγορέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος, ἀγορεύω, to speak in the assembly), [in LXX: Proverbes 24:66 (30:31), 4Ma.5:15 * ;] 
to deliver an oration: Actes 12:21.†

G1216.def:
Δημήτριος, -ου, ὁ 
Demetrius; 
__1. a silversmith, Actes 19:24 38. 
__2. A Christian disciple, III Jn 12.†

G1217.def:
δημιουργός, -οῦ, ὑ
(δῆμος, ἔργον), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:1 * ;] 
__1. one who works for the people. 
__2. Univ., an author, builder, maker; the maker of the world (Xen., Mem., I, 4, 9, al.), Hébreux 11:10.†
SYN.: κτίστης, creator, τεχνίτης, craftsman, designer. In He, l.with, τ. has reference to the plan, δ. to its execution.

G1218.def:
δῆμος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;] 
__1. a district, country. 
__2. the common people, the people generally; esp. the people assembled: Actes 12:22 17:5 19:30 33.
† SYN.: λαός, the people at large: δ., the people as a body politic; opposite to δ. is ὄχλος, the unorganized multitude. ἔθνος, in sing., means in NT as in Gk. writers generally, a nation, but in pl. denotes the rest of mankind apart from the Jews: Gentiles. λ. also, rare in cl. (Att... λεώς), is frequently in LXX and NT, and usually limited to the chosen people, Israel (cf. Cl. Rev., i, 42 f.; Cremer, 689).

G1220.def:
δηνάριον, -ου, τό 
the Lat. denarius, a Roman coin, nearly equal to the δραχμή, which see: Matthieu 18:28 20:2, 9, 13 22:19, Marc 6:37 12:15 14:5, Luc 7:41 10:35 20:24, Jean 6:7 12:5, Apocalypse 6:6; τὸ ἀνὰ δ., Matthieu 20:10.†

G1221.def:
δή-ποτε 
indef. adv. (also written δή ποτε), with generalizing force; 
__1. absol., sometime. 
__2. With adv. or relat., -soever: ᾦ δ., Jean 5:4 (L, οἱῳδηποτοῦν).†

G1225.def:
δια-βάλλω 
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:8, Da TH 3:8; 6:24 (25) (אֲכַל קְרַץ), 2Ma.3:11, 4Ma.4:1 * ;] 
__1. to throw across. 
__2. To slander, defame, accuse falsely or maliciously: Luc 16:1 (Cremer, 120).†

G1226.def:
δια-βεβαιόομαι, -οῦμαι 
to affirm confidently: Tite 3:8; before περί, 1 Timothée 1:7 (Cremer, 140).†

G1227.def:
δια-βλέπω 
__1. to took straight before one. 
__2. to see clearly: Matthieu 7:5, Marc 8:25, Luc 6:42 (cf. διάβλεψις, Aq., Ésaïe 61:1, for LXX ἀνάβ-).†

G1229.def:
δι-αγγέλω 
[in LXX for ספר pi., etc. ;] 
to publish abroad, proclaim: with accusative, Luc 9:60, Actes 21:26, Romains 9:17" (LXX) .†

G1230.def:
δια-γίνομαι
(Ion. and late Gk. for διαγίγν-), [in LXX, 2Ma.11:26 * ;] 
__1. to go through, to pass, e.g. τ. νύκτα; absol., to live. 
__2. Of time, to intervene, elapse: ptcp., with ἡμερῶν τινῶν, Actes 25:13; ἱκανοῦ χρόνου, ib. 27:9; τ. σαβάτου, Marc 16:1.†

G1231.def:
δια-γινώσκω
(see previous word), [in LXX chiefly for ידע, and cf. 2Ma.9:15 ;] 
__1. to distinguish, ascertain exactly: Actes 23:15 
__2. As Athen. law-term, to determine: τὰ καθ᾽ ὑμᾶς, your case, Actes 24:22 (Cremer, 673).†

G1233.def:
διά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαγιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.3:18 * ;] 
__1. a distinguishing, also as medical term. 
__2. As law-term (Lat. cognitio), determination, decision: Actes 25:21 (Cremer, 674).†

G1234.def:
δια-γογγύζω 
[in LXX chiefly for לין, לון, as Exode 16:2, and cf. Si 34(31):24 ;] 
of a number, to murmur or mutter among themselves: Luc 15:2 19:7.†

G1236.def:
δι-άγω 
[in LXX for עבר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to carry over. 
__2. Of time, to pass: βίον, 1 Timothée 2:2; absol., to live, before ἐν, Tite 3:3.†

G1237.def:
δια-δέχομαι 
[in LXX for מִשְׁנֶה (Deiss., BS, 115), פַּרְבָּר ;] 
to receive through another, receive in turn: Actes 7:45 (RV, in their turn; see Field, Notes, 116).†

G1238.def:
διάδημα, -τος, τό
(διαδέω, to bind round), [in LXX for כֶּתֶר (as Esther 1:11), etc. ;] 
the band round the τιάρα of a Persian king; a diadem, the badge of royalty: Apocalypse 12:3 13:1 19:12.†
SYN.: στέφανος, the badge of "victory, of valour, of nuptial joy, of festal gladness " (but see M, Th., i, 219; cf. DB, i, 530, 604).

G1239.def:
δια-διδωμι 
[in LXX for חלק pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to hand over, deliver: Apocalypse 17:13, Rec. 
__2. to distribute: Luc 11:22 18:22, Jean 6:11, Actes 4:35†

G1240.def:
διά-δοχος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(διαδέχομαι), [in LXX: 1 Chroniques 18:17 (לְיַד), 2 Chroniques 26:11 (שַׂר) 28:7 (מִשְׁנֶה), Sir.46:1 48:8, 2Ma.4:29 14:26 * ;] 
a successor: Actes 24:27 (for usage in LXX and π. in sense of court official, see Deiss., BS, 115).†

G1241.def:
δια-ζώννυμι, (also -ννύω) 
[in LXX for חֲגוֹר, Eze.23:15 A * ;] 
to gird round: ἑαυτόν, Jean 13:4; pass., ib. 13:5; mid., to gird oneself with: with accusative, Jean 21:7.†

G1242.def:
διαθήκη, -ης, ἡ
(διατίθημι), [frequently in LXX, and nearly always for בְּרִית ;] 
__1. as usually in cl., a disposition, testament, will (Plat., al.): Galates 3:15 (R, mg., but see Lft., in l.), Hébreux 9:16, 17 (R, txt.; MM, Exp., xi; Milligan, NTD, 75; Abbott, Essays, 107; Deiss., LAE, 341; but see infr.). 
__2. As in LXX (for בְּרִית) = cl. συνθήκη, a convention, arrangement, covenant (exc. in the disputed cases mentioned above, always between God and man, "perhaps with the feeling that the δια- compound was more suitable than the συν- for a covenant with God---συνθ. might suggest equal terms," MM, Exp., l.with): Galates 3:15 (R, txt., but see supr., and cf. Thayer, see word), Hébreux 9:16, 17 (R, mg., Westc., in l.; Hatch, Essays, 47; but see supr.), Matthieu 26:28, Marc 14:24, Luc 1:72, Actes 3:25 7:8, Romains 11:27" (LXX), 2 Corinthiens 3:14, Galates 3:17, Hébreux 7:22 8:6, ib. 9, 10" (LXX) 9:4, 15-17 20" (LXX) 10:16 (LXX), 29 12:24 13:20, Apocalypse 11:19; καινὴ δ., Matthieu 26:28, and Marc 14:24 (R, mg.), Luc 22:20, 1 Corinthiens 11:25, 2 Corinthiens 3:6, Hébreux 8:8" (LXX) 9:15; pl. Romains 9:4, Galates 4:24, Éphésiens 2:12.†

G1243.def:
δι-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(διαιρέω), [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲלֹקֶת ;] 
__1. a distinction, diference. 
__2. a division, distribution: 1 Corinthiens 12:4-6 (cf. διαιρέω; Cremer, 616).†

G1244.def:
δι-αιρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for בּתר (as Genèse 15:10), חלק (as Josué 18:5), etc. ;] 
__1. to divide into parts, cut asunder. 
__2. to distribute: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Luc 15:12, 1 Corinthiens 12:11.†

G1245.def:
δια-καθαρίζω
= θαίρω: Matthieu 3:12.†
δια-καθαίρω, 
to cleanse thoroughly: Luc 3:17.†

G1247.def:
διακονέω, ῶ
(δίακονος); 
__1. generally, to minister, serre, wait upon, especially at table, to do one a service, cure for one's needs: absol., Matthieu 20:28, Marc 10:45, Luc 10:40 22:26, 27, Jean 12:2, 1 Pierre 4:11; ὅσα διηκόνησεν, 2 Timothée 1:18; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 4:11 8:15 25:44 27:55, Marc 1:13, 31 15:41, Luc 4:39 8:3 12:37 17:8, Jean 12:26, Actes 6:2 19:22, Romains 15:25, Phm 13, Hébreux 6:10. 
__2. to serve as deacon: 1 Timothée 3:10, 3:13. 
__3. C. accusative of thing(s), to minister, supply, supply by ministration: 1 Pierre 1:12 4:10; pass., 2 Corinthiens 3:3 8:19, 20.†
SYN.: λειτουργέω, which see (Cremer, 179).

G1248.def:
διακονία, -ας, ἡ
(διάκονος), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: Esther 6:3, Esther 6:5 A; 1Ma.11:58 * ;] 
the office and work of a διάκονος, service, ministry; 
__(a) of domestic duties (Field, Notes, 63): Luc 10:40 
__(b) spec. of religious ministration, and the exercise of ministerial functions in the Church: Actes 1:17, 25 6:1, 4 11:29 12:25 20:24; 21:19, Romains 11:13 12:7 15:31, 1 Corinthiens 16:15, 2 Corinthiens 4:1 6:3 8:4 9:1, 13, Éphésiens 4:12, Colossiens 4:17, 1 Timothée 1:12, 2 Timothée 4:5, 11, Hébreux 1:14, Apocalypse 2:19; δ. τ. θανάτου, 2 Corinthiens 3:7; τ. πνεύματος, 2Co. 3:8; τ. κατακρίσεως, τ, δικαιοσύνης, 2Co. 3:9; τ. καταλλαγῆς, 2Co. 5:18; τ. λειτουργίας, 2Co. 9:12; with obj. genitive, τὴν ὑμῶν δ., ib. 11:8; pl., 1 Corinthiens 12:5.†

G1249.def:
διάκονος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
(derivation unknown), [in LXX for נַעַר, שָׁרַת pi.: Esther 6:3, 5, א B Esther 1:10 2:2, Proverbes 10:4, 4Ma.9:17 * ;] 
__1. in general, a servant, attendant, minister: Matthieu 20:26 22:13 23:11, Marc 9:35 10:43, Jean 2:5, 9, 1 Corinthiens 3:5, Galates 2:17, Éphésiens 6:21, Colossiens 4:7; δ. θεοῦ, Romains 13:4, 2 Corinthiens 6:4, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:2; δ. Χριστοῦ, 2 Corinthiens 11:23, Colossiens 1:7, 1 Timothée 4:6; cf. ὁ δ. ὁ ἐμός, Jean 12:26; δ. περιτομῆς, Romains 15:8; δ. καινῆς διαθήκης, 2 Corinthiens 3:6; δ. δικαιοσύνης, 2 Corinthiens 11:15; δ. [εὐαγγελίου], Éphésiens 3:7, Colossiens 1:23; δ. [ἐκκλησίας], Colossiens 1:25. 
__2. As technical term for Church officer (so in pre-Christian times, see M, Th., I, 32), a deacon: Philippiens 1:1, 1 Timothée 3:8, 12; fem. (cf. Eccl. διακονίσσα), Romains 16:1 (cf. 1 Timothée 3:11, and CGT, in l., also M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: δοῦλος, bondman; θεράπων, servant acting voluntarily; ὑπηρέτης, servant, attendant, by etymol. suggesting subordination. All these imply relation to a person, in distinction from which δ. represents rather the servant in relation to his work. Cf. also λειτουργός, a public servant, in which the idea of service to the community is prominent; οἰκέτης, a house servant.

G1250.def:
διακόσιοι, -αι, -α 
two hundred: Marc 6:37, and al.

G1251.def:
δι-ακούω 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 1:16 (שׁמע), Job 9:33 (יָד שִׁית hi.)* ;] 
to hear through, hear fully; technically, to hear judicially (as De, l.with; of. Deiss., BS, 230): Actes 23:35.†

G1252.def:
δια-κρίνω 
[in LXX for שׁפט, דִּין, etc. ;] 
__1. to separate, hence, to distinguish, discriminate, discern: μηδὲν δ., Actes 11:12; οὐδὲν δ. μεταξύ, Actes 15:9; σε, 1 Corinthiens 4:7; τὸ σῶμα, 1 Corinthiens 11:29. 
__2. to settle, decide, judge, arbitrate: Matthieu 16:3, 1 Corinthiens 6:5 11:29 (ICC, in l.), ib. 31 14:29. Mid, and pass.; 
__1. to get a decision, contend, dispute: before πρός, Actes 11:2; with dative (but see ICC, in l.), Ju 9; absol., Ju 22 (R,mg.). 
__2. Hellenistic (NT and Eccl., but not LXX), to be divided in one's mind, to hesitate, doubt: Matthieu 21:21 Romains 14:23, Jacques 1:6; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Jacques 2:4; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Marc 11:23; μηδὲν δ., Actes 10:20; δ. τ. ἀπιστίᾳ, Romains 4:20, Ju 22 (R, txt.).†

G1253.def:
διά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(διακρίνω) [in LXX for מִפְלָשׂ, Job 37:16 * ;] 
the act of judgment, discernment: Romains 14:1, 1 Corinthiens 12:10, Hébreux 5:14.†

G1254.def:
δια-κωλεύω 
[in LXX: Jdth.4:7 12:7 * ;] 
to hinder, prevent: with accusative, Matthieu 3:14.†

G1255.def:
δια-λαλέω, -ῶ 
[in Sm.: Ps 50(51):16, and al. ;] 
__1. to talk with: πρός, Luc 6:11. 
__2. to talk over: pass., Luc 1:65.†

G1256.def:
δια-λέγομαι
(mid. of διαλέγω, to pick out, distinguish, as depon.), [in LXX: Exode 6:27, Ésaïe 63:1 (דּבר pi.), Juges 8:1 (ריב), 1Es.8:46, Esther 5:2, Sir.14:20, 2Ma.11:20 * ;] 
to converse with, discourse (see Cl. Rev., i, 45), discuss, argue: Actes 18:4 19:8,9 20:9; with dative of person(s), Actes 17:17 18:19 20:7, Hébreux 12:5; before πρός, Marc 9:34, Actes 17:17 24:12; περί Actes 24:25, Ju 9; ἀπὸ τ. γραφῶν, Actes 17:2.†

G1257.def:
δια-λείπω 
[in LXX for יחל (as 1 Rois 10:8), etc. ;] 
to intermit, leave off for a time: Luc 7:45.†

G1258.def:
διά-λεκτος, -ου, ἡ
(διαλέγομαι), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:4 (לָשׁוֹן), Esther 9:26 * ;] 
__1. conversation, discourse, speech (Plat., Dem., al.). 
__2. As in Polyb. and later writers, the language or dialect of a particular country or district: Actes 1:19 2:6, 8 21:40 22:2 26:14.†

G1259.def:
δι-αλλάσσω 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 29:4 (רָצָה hithp.), I Esther 4:31, al. ;] 
__1. to change, exchange. 
__2. to change enmity for friendship, to reconcile: pass., with dative of person(s), Matthieu 5:24. "The word denotes mutual concession after mutual hostility, an idea absent from καταλλ-," which see (Lft., Notes, 288; cf. Deiss., LAE, 178.15; Cremer, 91, 632).†

G1260.def:
δια-λογίζομαι, depon. 
[in LXX chiefly for חשׁב, frequently in Pss. ;] 
__1. to balance accounts (Dem.). 
__2. to consider, reason (Isocr.): Luc 1:29 5:21; ἐν τ. καρδία, Marc 2:6, 8, Luc 5:22; περί Luc 3:15; ἐν ἑαυτῷ (-οῖς), Matthieu 16:7-8, Marc 2:8, Luc 12:17; πρὸς ἑ., Marc 9:33 11:31, Luc 20:14; παρ᾽ ἑ., Matthieu 21:25 (ἐν ἑ., T, WH, mg.); πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Marc 8:16; ὅτι, Marc 8:17, Jean 11:50, Rec. (DB, i, 611; Cremer, 400).†

G1261.def:
δια-λογισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαλογίζομαι) [in LXX chiefly for מַחֲשָׁבָה ;] 
a thought, reasoning, inward questioning: Matthieu 15:19, Marc 7:21, Luc 2:35 5:22 6:8 9:46, 47 24:38, Romains 1:21 14:1, 1 Corinthiens 3:20" (LXX), Philippiens 2:14; κριταὶ δ. πονηρῶν, genitive of qual. (cf. Proverbes 12:5), Jacques 2:4; χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ δ. (where perh. δ., like מְזִמָּה, in Ps 138(139):20, al., implies evil intention), 1 Timothée 2:8 (see Hort, in l.; cf. Cremer, 400).†

G1262.def:
δια-λύω 
[in LXX for אבה, חבל, etc. ;] 
to part asunder, dissolve; of an assembly, pass., to disperse: Actes 5:36.†

G1263.def:
δια-μαρτύρομαι, depon., of Ionic origin, intensive of the simple μαρτύρομαι, which see, 
[in LXX chiefly for עוּד hi., usually with dative of person(s), Deutéronome 4:26 8:19, 1 Rois 8:9, al. ;] 
solemnly to protest: Luc 16:28, Actes 2:40 8:25 10:42 18:5 20:21, 23, 24 23:11 28:23, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:6, Hébreux 2:6; in adjuration, before ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1 Timothée 5:21, 2 Timothée 2:14 4:1 (Cremer, 415).†

G1264.def:
δια-μάχομαι 
[in LXX for לחם ni., Dan LXX 10:20; Sir.8:1, 3 38:28 51:19 * ;] 
__1. to struggle against. 
__2. In argument, to contend: Actes 23:9.†

G1265.def:
δια-μένω 
[in LXX for עמד, etc.;] 
to remain, continue: Luc 1:22 22:28, Galates 2:5, Hébreux 1:11" (LXX), 2 Pierre 3:4.†

G1266.def:
δια-μερίζω 
[in LXX chiefly for חלק pi. ;] 
__1. to distribute: with dative of person(s), Actes 2:45; before εἰς, Luc 22:17, pass., Actes 2:3. Mid. to distribute among themselves: Matthieu 27:35, Marc 15:24, Luc 23:34; with redundant ἑαυτοῖς, Jean 19:24 (LXX) (see M, Pr., 157). 
__2. to divide, separate: pass., before ἐπί, with accusative, Luc 11:17-18; ἐπί, with dative, Luc 12:52-53.†

G1267.def:
δια-μερισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(διαμερίζω), [in LXX: Eze.48:29 (מַחֲלֹקֶת), Michée 7:12 * ;] 
a division: opposite to εἰρήνη, Luc 12:51.†

G1268.def:
δια-νέμω 
[in LXX for חלק, Deutéronome 29:25 * ;] 
to distribute, divide: pass., to be spread about, Actes 4:17.†

G1269.def:
δια-νεύω 
[in LXX: Ps 34(35):19 (קרץ), Sir.27:22 * ;] 
to wink at, nod to, beckon to: Luc 1:22.†

G1270.def:
δια-νόημα, -τος, τό
(διανοέομαι, to think), [in LXX for מַחֲשָׁבָה, etc., Ésaïe 55:9, al., frequently in Sir ;] 
a thought: Luc 11:17.†

G1271.def:
διάνοια, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for לֵב, לֵבָב ;] 
the understanding, mind: Luc 1:51, Éphésiens 4:18, Colossiens 1:21, 1 Pierre 1:13, 2 Pierre 3:1, 1 Jean 5:20; pl., Éphésiens 2:3; in quotations from LXX, Matthieu 22:37, Marc 12:30, Luc 10:27, Hébreux 8:10 10:16 (Cremer, 79, 438).†

G1272.def:
δι-αν-οίγω 
[in LXX for פֶּטֶר (Ex, Nu), פָּקַח, פָּתַח, etc. ;] 
to open up completely, to open: Luc 2:23 (LXX); pass., Marc 7:34, Actes 7:56. Metaphorical, δ. τ. νοῦν, Luc 24:45, τ. καρδίαν, Actes 16:14, pass., οἱ ὀφθαλμοί, Luc 24:31; of explaining, τ. γραφάς, Luc 24:32, Actes 17:3.†

G1273.def:
δια-νυκτερεύω
(cf. διημερεύω, to pass the day) [in LXX: Job 2:9 * ;] 
to pass the night: before ἐν τ. προσευχῆ, Luc 6:12.†

G1274.def:
δι-ανύω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:17 * ;] 
__1. to accomplish fully, finish, complete: Actes 21:7 (EV). 
__2. In late writers (Xen., al., Clem., I ad Cor., xxv, 3), to continue: Ac, l.with (Field, Notes, 134f.).†

G1276.def:
δια-περάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 30:13, Ésaïe 23:2 (עבר), עבר), 1Ma.6:1-63 * ;] 
to pass over, cross over: Matthieu 9:1; before ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Matthieu 14:34, Marc 6:53; εἰς, Marc 5:21, Actes 21:2; πρὸς ἡμᾶς, Luc 16:28.†

G1277.def: to sail across , Thuc.; εἰς Αἴγιναν (Aristophanes Comicus): metaphorically, δ. βίον to make life's voyage , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G1278.def:
δια-πονέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 10:9 (עָצַב ni.), 2Ma.2:28; in Aq.: Genèse 6:6, 1 Rois 20:3 * ;] 
to work out with labour. Pass., to be worn out, sore troubled: Marc 14:4 (WH, mg.), Actes 4:2 16:18.†

G1279.def:
δια-πορεύω 
[in LXX for עָבַר, הָלַךְ, etc. ;] 
to carry over. Pass., to pass across, journey through: absol., Luc 18:36, Romains 15:24; before κατὰ πόλεις κ. κώμας, Luc 13:22; διά, with genitive, Marc 2:23, Luc 6:1 (cf. Proverbes 9:12 with, Wis.3:1); with accusative, Actes 16:4.†

G1280.def:
δι-απορέω, -ῶ 
[in Sm.: Psaumes 77:5, Daniel 2:1 * ;] 
to be quite at a loss, be in great perplexity: absol., Actes 2:12; before διὰ τό, with inf., Luc 9:7; περί, Actes 5:24; ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Actes 10:17.†

G1282.def:
δια-πρίω 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 20:3 (סוּר) * ;] 
to saw asunder. Pass., metaphorically (vernacular?), EV, cut to the heart: Actes 5:33; before τ. καρδίαις αὐτῶν, Actes 7:54.†

G1283.def:
δι-αρπάζω 
[in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;] 
to plunder: Matthieu 12:29, Marc 3:27.†

G1284.def:
δια-ρήσσω (so WH, exc. Ac, l.with), δια-ρρήσσω 
(poetic and late form of διαρρήγνυμι), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
to break asunder, burst, rend: δεσμά, Luc 8:29; pass., δίκτυα, Luc 5:6; ἱμάτια, χιτῶνας, in grief or anger (as Genèse 37:29, al.), Matthieu 26:65, Actes 14:14, Marc 14:63.†

G1285.def:
δια-σαφέω, -ῶ
(σαφής, clear), [in LXX: Deutéronome 1:5 (בָּאַר pi.), Dan LXX 2:6 (חָוָה aphel.), I-III Ma 9 * ;] 
to make clear, explain fully: with accusative of thing(s), dative of person(s), Matthieu 13:26 18:31.†

G1286.def:
δια-σείω 
[in LXX: Job 4:14 (פָּחַד hi.), 3Ma.7:21 * ;] 
to shake violently; metaphorically, to intimidate: Luc 3:14.†

G1287.def:
δια-σκορπίζω 
[in LXX for פּוּץ, זָרָה, etc. ;] 
to scatter abroad, disperse: of sheep, Matthieu 26:31 = Marc 14:27" (LXX) ; of persons, Luc 1:51, Actes 5:37, opposite to συνάγω, Jean 11:52; of winnowing grain, Matthieu 25:24, 26; metaphorically, of property, to squander, waste: Luc 15:13 16:1.†

G1288.def:
δια-σπάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for נָתַק, as Juges 16:9 ;] 
to break or tear asunder: pass., ἁλύσεις, Marc 5:4; Παῦλος, Actes 23:10.†

G1289.def:
δια-σπείρω 
[frequently in LXX for פּוּץ, etc. ;] 
to scatter abroad, disperse: Actes 8:1, 4 11:19.†

G1290.def:
δια-σπορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(διασπείρω), [in LXX of Israelites dispersed and exiled in foreign lands, as Deutéronome 28:25 (זַעֲוָה) Deutéronome 30:4 (נָדַח ni.), Ésaïe 49:6 (נער); by meton., of the exiles themselves (as Psaumes 147:2, 2Ma.1:27) ;] 
a dispersion: δ. τῶν Ἑλλήνων, Jean 7:35; metaphorically, of Christians (DB, iii, 782 f.), Jacques 1:1, 1 Pierre 1:1 (see Hort, in ll).†

G1291.def:
δια-στελλω 
[in LXX for בָּדַל hi. (Deutéronome 10:8, al.), זְהַר hi. (Eze.3:18-19, al.), and 19 other words] 
__1. to divide, distinguish, define. 
__2. to command, charge expressly: pass., τὸ διαστελλόμενον, Hébreux 12:20. Mid., in late Gk. with same sense (so Ez, l.with; and al. in LXX; MM, see word); a. dative of person(s), Marc 8:15, Actes 15:24; before ἵνα, Matthieu 16:20, Marc 5:43 7:36 9:9.†

G1292.def:
διάστημα, -τος, τό
(διίστημι), [in LXX for רֶוַח, etc. ;] 
an interval, space: of time (Sir, prol. 24), Actes 5:7.†

G1293.def:
δια-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(διαστέλλω), [in LXX for פְּדוּת: Exode 8:23, etc. ;] 
__1. a separation. 
__2. a distinction, difference: Romains 3:22 10:12, 1 Corinthiens 14:7.†

G1294.def:
δια-στρέφω 
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, עָקַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to distort, twist; metaphorically, to distort, pervert: Luc 23:2, Actes 13:8, 10; διεστραμμένος, perverse: Matthieu 17:17, Luc 9:41, Actes 20:30, Philippiens 2:15.†

G1295.def:
δια-σώζω 
[in LXX for מָלַט, יָשַׁע, etc. ;] 
to bring safely through a danger: Luc 7:3, Actes 27:43; before πρός, Actes 23:24. Pass., to come safe through: Actes 28:1; ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Actes 27:44; ἐκ τ. θαλάσσης, Actes 28:4; δι᾽ ὕδατος, 1 Pierre 3:20; of sickness, to recover: Matthieu 14:36.†

G1297.def:
διά-ταγμα, -τος, τό
(διατάσσω), [in LXX: Esther 7:11 (נִשְׁתְּוָן), Esther 3:13, Wis.11:7 * ;] 
an edict, mandate: Hébreux 11:23.†

G1298.def:
δια-ταράσσω 
[in Sm.: 3Ki.20:43 * ;] 
to agitate greatly (Lat. perturbare): Luc 1:29,†

G1299.def:
δια-τάσσω 
[in LXX for שׂוּם, שָׁמַר, etc. ;] 
to charge, give orders to, appoint, arrange, ordain: with dative, Matthieu 11:1, 1 Corinthiens 9:14 16:1; before inf., Luc 8:55, Actes 18:2. Mid., 1 Corinthiens 7:17, Actes 20:13; with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 11:34; with dative, Tite 1:5; before inf., Actes 7:44 24:23. Pass., τὸ διατεταγμένον, Luc 3:13, Actes 23:31; τὰ διαταχθέντα, Luc 17:9-10; διαταγείς, Galates 3:19.†
